tex_content.label: capball
tex_content.html: For sufficiently small $\delta $ and $\epsilon <1/200$, the surgery cap lies in \[ B_{\widetilde g} \bigl(p_0,R(x_0)^{-1/2}(A_0+5)\bigr) \] and contains \[ B_{\widetilde g} \bigl(p_0,R(x_0)^{-1/2}(A_0+3)\bigr). \] The complement of its closure is isometric to $N^-$.
